In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], there was a '''skirmish aboard a [[Rebel ship of the line]]''' when [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Damon Krell]] sent an [[Infiltrator probe droid]] to trap and attack [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].
